title: Eleven Years of River
subtitle: 民族国家 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 民族国家（历史社会与文化·民族与国家）
meta: 主题语境：民族国家（历史社会与文化·民族与国家）　|　核心词汇：border　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 border 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to draw ① a border she could not cross, and she said the crossing was the whole of the lesson. The ② border, meaning the line and not the land, was ninety miles long and was walked by whoever came last; a border, she said, is the only thing in an atlas that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ border in that atlas had the same river, and the ④ border at the north, meaning the one the officer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever walked properly. A border, my grandmother said, is nine parts paper and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the paper is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ border was the whole of the country, meaning the nation it made and not the line. The ⑥ border, meaning the nation and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody crosses and nobody questions; a border, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a line and a nation. She said the nation is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ border had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the river. The ⑧ border of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was ninety miles of line and eleven years of walking; a border, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ border I remember is the one at the north, which was redrawn in 1972 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ border, my grandmother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being crossed; every border, she said, is a nation that has agreed to look like a line. She said the nation was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 边界（指那条线本身，与土地相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a border 画一条边界线
D. n. 边界（指地图册上每一条）
E. n. 边界（指北面那一条）
F. n. 边界（抽象：它造就的那个国家）
G. n. 那个国家（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a border she could not cross
The border, meaning the line and not the land
border was the whole of the country
the border had become a photograph in a report
The border of the whole thing
A border, my grandmother said in 1981

answers.why: draw a border 意为“画一条边界线”，1946 年母亲被派去画一条她过不去的边界。
border 意为“边界”，指那条线本身而不是土地，长九十英里，由最后走的人走过。
border 指地图册上每一条边界，每一条都依着同一条河。
border 指北面那一条（军官守的那一条），是唯一有人认真走完过的。
border 意为“边界”，抽象指它造就的那个国家，父亲说 border 就是那个国家的全部。
border 为抽象用法，指那个国家本身，是一个世纪里人人都跨越、却没人质疑的东西。
border 意为“边界、国界”，到 1966 年这条 border 成了报告里的一张照片。
border 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九十英里的线和十一年的行走。
border 意为“边界”，我记得的是北面那一条，1972 年重画，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
border 为抽象总称，祖母说边界是唯一会因为被跨越而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1946 年母亲被派去画一条她过不去的边界，她说跨过去才是这堂课的全部。（draw a border）
那条边界，指的是那条线本身而不是土地，长九十英里，由最后走的人走过。（border）
那本地图册上每一条边界都依着同一条河。（border）
北面那条边界，指的是军官守的那一条，是唯一有人认真走完过的。（border）
父亲说 border 就是那个国家的全部，指的是它造就的国家而不是那条线。（border）
1981 年祖母说，边界是唯一会因为被跨越而变好的东西。（border）
answers: In 1946 my mother was sent to draw a border she could not cross, and she said the crossing was the whole of the lesson.
The border, meaning the line and not the land, was ninety miles long and was walked by whoever came last.
Every border in that atlas had the same river.
The border at the north, meaning the one the officer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever walked properly.
My father said border was the whole of the country, meaning the nation it made and not the line.
A border, my grandmother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being crossed.
